title: Sage decal record
description: A decal record (DecalRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another decal record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

texture.description: The image laid on the surface (required) A texture path. (AssetPath)

material.description: What it draws with; empty = the engine's blended decal material (sage:decal) Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

size.description: How wide the square is on the surface. Unit: m. At least 0.001. (float, default 0.2)

lifetime.description: How long it stays; 0 = until the pool needs its room. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 30)

fade.description: Seconds over the end of its lifetime it fades out; no more than the lifetime. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 2)

colour.description: Tint and opacity, "#RRGGBB(AA)"; white leaves the texture as it is. (uint, default "#FFFFFFFF")

randomRotation.description: Turned a random amount about the surface's normal, so a row of holes does not look stamped. (bool, default true)

reach.description: How far from where something happened it may land: behind a wounded target along the blow, or below a burst. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 2)
